TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd has executed multiple Hospital IT deployments and large-scale, government-facing enterprise implementations that align with the Provincial Health Department’s requirement to supply, implement, integrate, and support an integrated HMIS across tertiary-care hospitals [CO-PROFILE]. Within the last five years, our most directly relevant health-sector engagements include:

CAP-018 – Hospital IT deployment (Provincial Government), PKR 66M, 28 months, completed 2023 [CAP-018]. CAP-030 – Hospital IT deployment (International client), PKR 64M, 33 months, completed 2022 [CAP-030].

These hospital deployments demonstrate recent delivery experience in the healthcare domain and provide verifiable past performance against complex, multi-module hospital system rollouts [CAP-018][CAP-030]. Complementing this, we have delivered enterprise ERP implementations up to PKR 188M over 34 months, evidencing governance, change management, and sustained delivery discipline applicable to multi-site HMIS programs [CAP-038].

For the RFP’s information security and auditability expectations, we hold ISO 27001 and have delivered ISO 27001-aligned technology programs, including cloud infrastructure deployments for Federal Government, demonstrating secure platforms suitable for centralized data warehousing and dashboard workloads [CO-PROFILE][CAP-012].

Our library does not yet evidence HL7 v2.x / FHIR R4 interface delivery, a documented structured legacy clinical-data migration and reconciliation methodology, or measured 99.5% monthly availability with a 4-hour RTO DR site; we will address these through a dedicated interoperability and migration workstream and by engineering the required HA/DR architecture as part of the proposed solution.

We will staff the engagement with PMP-certified project management resources [CO-PROFILE]. Our standard support model is an in-country support desk with 24–48h response SLAs [CO-PROFILE]; for KP’s four hospitals and the required three-year O&M, we will implement an enhanced 24/7 helpdesk and SLA regime tailored to clinical operations.
